description: Stylescape calibration set: twelve fictional brands, one page each, all following the ten-section stylescape format. Atlas IDs refer to library/atlas/registry.json. Palette lists three representative colors (canvas or key ground, primary text or contrast color, accent).

brands.name: Vibra
brands.brief: Vibra: a no-fee neobank for Gen Z in Brazil, Pix-first, Portuguese copy.
brands.key_visual: Landing hero with two app screens: home balance and a calm Pix review screen.
brands.author: A
brands.note: Category-breaking fintech. Look at how the loud layer (3px outlines, hard shadows, stickers) stops at the money screens: the Pix review, errors and fees are calm and conventional. One variable family covers display to body through its optical-size axis.

brands.name: Little Harbor
brands.brief: Little Harbor: pediatric telehealth for parents of young kids.
brands.key_visual: Night-harbor landing hero: lighthouse beam reaching a lit house, with a live visit card.
brands.author: A
brands.note: Two styles split by job: rounded, illustrated shapes for warmth and the child; a clinical system (Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, 56px inputs, one action per screen) for tired parents. No red in the brand palette so real warnings stay unmistakable.

brands.name: Kiyomi House
brands.brief: Kiyomi House: an eight-room boutique inn in Kyoto, bilingual JA/EN.
brands.key_visual: Shoji screen with a maple-branch shadow, vertical Japanese headline and a booking strip.
brands.author: A
brands.note: Luxury as restraint without low-contrast grey text: the palest text color is 5.67:1. Vertical Japanese (writing-mode: vertical-rl) carries the voice; English is transcreated, not translated. Japanese fonts are subset to the page's glyphs, so re-subset after changing copy.

brands.name: Gridline
brands.brief: Gridline: industrial IoT monitoring for plant operators.
brands.key_visual: Operator overview for one bottling line: KPI strip, process mimic, alarm list, torque trend, work orders.
brands.author: A
brands.note: High-performance HMI thinking (ISA-101): greyscale for normal, color only for abnormal, and every alarm coded by shape, number and color. The headline is an insight sentence (finding, then cause), backed by the trend chart.

brands.name: STATIC
brands.brief: STATIC: limited streetwear drops for teens, released online.
brands.key_visual: Drop page: distressed headline, OS-window countdown, hoodie taped onto a torn photocopy, chrome price sticker.
brands.author: A
brands.note: Texture and SVG displacement filters only on display type and art, never on prices, sizes, forms or body copy. The ticker has a pause control; glitches are offset-only (no brightness flashes); scarcity claims must be true.

brands.name: Finca Alba
brands.brief: Finca Alba: single-origin Puerto Rican coffee, bilingual ES/EN packaging.
brands.key_visual: Packaging line-up at dawn: kraft bag with a three-ink linocut label, espresso tin and a handwritten tag.
brands.author: A
brands.note: Heritage label grammar localized to Puerto Rico: flor de maga red (not the flag), the Cordillera, Spanish first with equal-weight English. Specified as three spot inks on kraft; the net-quantity statement sits in the bottom of the front panel.

brands.name: Harlow & Vance
brands.brief: Harlow & Vance: a litigation and appeals law firm.
brands.key_visual: Firm website that reads like a well-made brief: pleading-paper margins and line numbers.
brands.author: B
brands.note: Authority through the conventions of the work itself (pleading paper, Caslon, outcomes stated plainly) rather than columns, gavels or navy-and-gold.

brands.name: Tidewater Collective
brands.brief: Tidewater Collective: a coastal climate-resilience nonprofit raising donations.
brands.key_visual: Field-magazine donation site: every appeal is a report with a place, a number, a date and a source.
brands.author: B
brands.note: Editorial credibility instead of pity imagery: shoreline cross-sections, sourced numbers and a donation flow with impact labels.

brands.name: Apex Wolves
brands.brief: Apex Wolves: an esports team's season launch.
brands.key_visual: Season 07 launch across social: match-day and result posts, roster numbers as heroes.
brands.author: B
brands.note: Traditional sports-club discipline (one angle, one signal color, numbers as heroes) plus a dark HUD layer; explicitly no RGB glow and no glitch.

brands.name: CareFill
brands.brief: CareFill: prescription refills and reminders for adults 65+.
brands.key_visual: App screens at actual size: today's doses with a large I-took-it button, refill ready.
brands.author: B
brands.note: Public-service plainness for older adults and their families: big type, one task per screen, a yellow focus ring, nothing to decode.

brands.name: Noor Atelier
brands.brief: Noor Atelier: Arabic-first modest-fashion e-commerce in the UAE, RTL.
brands.key_visual: Right-to-left storefront: light falling through an arch onto an abaya.
brands.author: B
brands.note: Classic luxury serif translated into Arabic as Amiri's Naskh; the whole page runs right to left with Arabic customer copy.

brands.name: Forge
brands.brief: Forge: a CLI and cloud for deploying AI agents, for developers.
brands.key_visual: Annotated engineering drawing of real agent code and its deploy output.
brands.author: B
brands.note: The Magician shows the method: real code annotated like a shop drawing, warm graphite and one amber signal, no glow and no fake terminal.
